agency: Housing Authority of Clackamas County (HACC) — Affordable Housing & Rental Assistance
notes: The Housing Authority of Clackamas County provides affordable apartments and rental assistance for individuals and families with limited incomes. Programs include Housing Choice Vouchers (Section 8), public housing, and housing connected to specific apartment communities. All HACC waitlists are currently closed. Visit the official website for eligibility information and future openings.

agency: Vancouver Housing Authority — Affordable Housing & Rental Assistance
notes: Vancouver Housing Authority has one current opening: the Columbia House senior-housing waitlist is open from August 27 through September 17, 2026. The Housing Choice Voucher waitlist, Project-Based Voucher waitlists, family waitlist, and most other VHA-owned or managed property waitlists are closed. Meriwether Place is referral-only. Check the official page before applying because each list has a separate status.

agency: King County Housing Authority — Subsidized Housing — Property Waitlists
notes: King County Housing Authority provides subsidized apartments for individuals and families with limited incomes. Its waiting list is temporarily closed to new applicants while the agency updates its housing system. No reopening date has been announced. Visit the official website for reopening updates or call 206-574-1248.

agency: Seattle Housing Authority — Housing Choice Voucher (Section 8)
notes: Seattle Housing Authority’s Housing Choice Voucher program helps people with low incomes pay rent from participating landlords. Applications are open year-round, and applicants are selected at random when vouchers become available. Applicants must check in every month to remain on the list. Visit the official website to review eligibility and apply, or call 206-239-1674 for assistance.

agency: Cascadia Health — Affordable Housing — Centennial Place Apartments
notes: Centennial Place Apartments offers affordable studio, one-bedroom, and two-bedroom apartments in Portland for individuals and families with limited incomes. The waitlist is currently closed. Visit Cascadia Health’s website for eligibility requirements, rent information, and updates about future openings.

agency: Cascadia Health — Affordable Housing — Midland Commons Apartments
notes: The non-subsidized Midland Commons waitlist opened August 25, 2026 and will remain open until the currently available units are filled. The opening covers studio, one-bedroom, and two-bedroom apartments at 2830 SE 127th Ave., Portland. Applicants must have qualifying income or tenant-based voucher/rental assistance. Use the official property page to apply online or by email; questions: waitlist@cascadiahealth.org or 971-380-3164.

agency: Tacoma Housing Authority — Affordable Housing & Rental Assistance
notes: Tacoma Housing Authority has two open waitlists: one for affordable apartments owned by the housing authority and another for rental vouchers that help pay rent in Tacoma. People may apply to either waitlist or both. After applying, applicants must log in every January, April, July, and October to confirm they still need assistance. Visit the official website for application instructions or call 253-207-4400.

agency: Hacienda CDC — Affordable Housing — Dolores Apartments
notes: Dolores Apartments offers affordable one-, two-, three-, and four-bedroom homes in Hillsboro for households that meet income requirements. Applications are currently being accepted. Visit the Dolores Apartments website for current availability, income limits, and application information, or call 971-515-8137.

agency: Housing Authority of Washington County — Affordable Housing & Rental Assistance
notes: Washington County offers affordable housing and rental assistance for individuals and families with limited incomes. Place-based housing waitlists are currently open, including apartments connected to public housing and project-based assistance. The Housing Choice Voucher (Section 8) waitlist remains closed. Visit the official website for available locations, eligibility requirements, and application information.

agency: Bienestar Oregon — Affordable Housing — Armonía Apartments
notes: Armonía Apartments is an upcoming affordable housing community in McMinnville with studio, one-bedroom, two-bedroom, and three-bedroom homes. Some apartments will be reserved for farmworkers. Applications are not open yet, and leasing is expected to begin in winter 2027. Visit Bienestar Oregon’s website to submit the inquiry form and receive development and application updates.
